title: Chapter 2943 - 173: Wishing You Dead_3
content:
Chapter 2943: Chapter 173: Wishing You Dead_3

I don’t believe I’ve been fishing all my life, yet now I’ve truly been pulled into the vortex of Cause and Effect by a little fish.

The Pavilion Elder, having barely relaxed his brow, furrowed it deeply again:

"The trouble... has gotten big..."

"If it explodes one day, you can forget about living a peaceful life this lifetime..."

The Pavilion Elder pondered for a moment, then gently pinched his fingers, calculating just a bit more.

Calculating what Mo Hua had ultimately done in the Great Wilderness, calculating if he could extricate himself from this part of Cause and Effect...

But upon calculating, the Pavilion Elder’s expression changed immediately, his pupils suddenly shivering:

"This kid really knows how to stir trouble..."

"What on earth is he... rebelling against in the Great Wilderness, and in such a massive way?!"

Not just rebelling against people, but against the "gods"?

The Pavilion Elder took a cold breath, unable to resist a slight palpitation.

The situation in the Great Wilderness was too chaotic, the Heavenly secret clouded, the strategies intertwined, many experts were plotting, concealing and deceiving each other, making it hard to discern truth from deception.

If not for the fact that the Pavilion Elder had personally seen Mo Hua before, played chess with him, and held the "Wood Revitalization" Cause and Effect Line, he may not have realized what Mo Hua was doing.

Or rather, he wouldn’t have realized that the person doing all these things... was Mo Hua.

After all, who would have thought that he, a small disciple of the Taixu Gate, could run to the Great Wilderness, to rebel against the Great Wilderness, the Taoist Court, and even the deities of the Great Wilderness.

This child truly knows how to "rebel"...

The Pavilion Elder held his breath in his chest, unable to utter a word.

After a long while, the Pavilion Elder’s gaze gradually became solemn, he sighed deeply, and said softly:

"Doing such things... don’t you know how many people... want you dead..."

"The deities want to kill you, the Great Wilderness wants to kill you, the Barbarian Tribes want to kill you, the Taoist Court wants to kill you, the aristocratic families want to kill you... even your own divinity... will kill you..."

For a moment, the Pavilion Elder himself couldn’t help but consider letting this kid "die" in the Great Wilderness.

Dying in the Great Wilderness would sever the Cause and Effect.

No one would know about the things the Pavilion Elder had done.

His corpse would vanish along with the evidence, erasing the "accounts".

Preventing himself from later becoming an accomplice to a "terrorist" rebelling against deities, the Taoist Court, the Great Wilderness... not knowing what else he might rebel against in the future.

Thousands of years of illustrious reputation, destroyed in an instant.

The Pavilion Elder remained silent.

The thought of "let him die" surfaced repeatedly in his mind like a little demon monster.

But at the same time, that handsome and affectionate smile, those clear, water-like eyes, that Taoist Heart as jade temperament.

Also, those brief moments of being evenly matched in chess and mutual admiration continued to resonate in the Pavilion Elder’s heart.

Finally, the Pavilion Elder let out a deep sigh.

"A lifetime of toil, unable to bear even a bit of leisure..."

The Pavilion Elder slowly sat upright, looking at the chess game beside him.

This game, black and white clear, with a faint gleam of gold, seemed evenly matched, but it was nearing the "endgame" where life and death would be decided...

...

Third Grade Green Luyou Mountain Realm.

Within a secret cave.

Mo Hua opened his eyes.

In his pupils, a golden hue flashed by, yet this golden hue lacked the previous clarity and vigor, instead appearing deep and indifferent.

Like a deity opening their eyes to observe the world.

At the same time, deep blue light suddenly flashed around Mo Hua, Taotie Patterns resembling "Formation creatures" under his skin, lighting up from his bones, circulating along the Twelve regular meridians in a full Circulation.

Amidst the blue light, a faint golden jade light revealed itself.

This was the Wood White Gold Jade Bone.

And within this golden jade light, there was a trace of Wood Qi intermingled.

This was the Wood Revitalization Formation.

At this moment, Mo Hua’s own Life Formation system finally took complete form.

His aura suddenly increased by a small margin.

Foundation Establishment Peak.

With the forging of his own Magical Treasure, entering the stage of nurturing the Artifact Embryo within, signifies a cultivator truly stepping into the Foundation Establishment Peak realm.

Once the Magic Treasure is nurtured and the foundation is solidified, it can truly attempt to breakthrough to the Golden Core realm.

Entering Golden Core, the Great Dao undergoes a transformation, transforming one’s essence.

Mo Hua’s gaze held authority, his aura already showing the initial signs of "transformation".

Yet, as he was about to rise, he suddenly hesitated.

Because he discovered that during his Divine Sense Internal Observation and the single-minded forging of the Life Formation, some "peculiar" things had mysteriously appeared beside his external flesh body.

These things had sharp snouts and fangs, small eyes and long tails, pupils like Copper Coins, exuding an impure golden color, resembling Evil Spirits, or even Demon Monsters, secretly gnawing at his Dao body...

This is...

Mo Hua’s pupils slightly constricted.

"Money Rats?"
